# Hex <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Hex:String value:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | In | Int32 | required | The number to convert. |

**Returns:** A string of 8 digits, 0 to 9 and A to F.

## Description

Turns a number into hexadecimal digits. The result always has 8 digits, so negative numbers show their two's complement form.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Hex$(255)
Print Hex$(-1)
```

```text
000000FF
FFFFFFFF
```
